Best Independently Tested, All-Natural, GMP and NSF-Certified Microbiome Health Supplements

Welcome to our store offering the best independently tested, GMP and NSF-certified microbiome health supplements! Our mission is to provide safe, all-natural, and non-GMO nutritional supplements to support your health, beginning with your gut microbiome - the key to your immune system and general health. Our products include Omega-3, Turmeric, Glucosamine/Chondroitin joint support, Probiotic supplements, digestive enzymes with probiotics, apple cider vinegar, and fiber gummies.

Our store specializes in digestive supplements, with a wide range of products that cater to men and women. Our probiotics contain live organisms that repopulate your gut microbiome with beneficial bacteria that help you digest and metabolize your food effectively. Beyond regulating digestive health, these beneficial bacteria are also essential for mental acuity, mood, and energy levels, among others. Our line of probiotics includes Dr. Gutman’s Non-Dairy Probiotics with 40 Billion CFU, containing three types of Lactobacilli and Bifidobacterium.

Our formulas are third-party independently tested for heavy metals and impurities, made in the USA, GMP-certified, and produced in an FDA-registered facility. We take pride in our world-class standards, which only 1% of supplements on the market can match.

The western diet is often high in sugar and low in fiber, leading to an imbalance in the microbiome. Our store offers all-natural and safe supplements to help repair and strengthen your microbiome. Our products include prebiotic fiber, digestive enzymes with probiotics, and apple cider vinegar.

We are committed to providing the best microbiome health supplements to help you achieve optimal health. Our products are independently tested, certified, and made with your health in mind. Browse our selection today and discover the benefits of a healthy gut microbiome!
